_comment: Single source of truth for the websites and web apps portfolio. Rendered by js/portfolio.js on the homepage and /website-design. hasAiAgent must be TRUE only where a live agent genuinely exists on the public site.

_verification.method: Headless Chrome visit, 8s wait, looked for a fixed-position chat launcher.

found.yourcountant.com: NO launcher found on the marketing site or app.yourcountant.com
found.hydrocomlimited.com: WhatsApp link only (human, not an AI agent)

_verification.ownerTodo: Yourcountant is marked hasAiAgent:true because the owner confirmed it in CONVERSION_PLAN.md, but the automated check could not find it. Confirm, or set hasAiAgent to false and change the stat in config/site.json.

items.name: AnyStudents
items.label: own-product
items.summary: An AI tutoring platform used by students around the world. One-on-one interactive tutoring, study guides and mock exams, with a genuinely free daily tier.
highlights: A conversational AI tutor, free for thirty minutes every day.
Nine core subjects, each with a full study guide and curated resources.
Mock papers and adaptive practice for WAEC, BECE, JAMB, IGCSE and SAT.
items.agentPrompt: Ask: can you explain photosynthesis for BECE?

items.name: MockExams
items.label: own-product
items.summary: A mock exam generator for Ghanaian candidates sitting BECE and WASSCE. It writes fresh WAEC-standard papers on demand rather than recycling the same question bank every student has already seen.
highlights: Unique papers generated per subject, so practice never goes stale.
Marking schemes returned instantly, so a student can grade themselves the same evening.
First exam free, with no card required to start.
items.agentPrompt: Ask: how do I generate a BECE maths paper?

items.name: Yourcountant
items.label: own-product
items.summary: Shop bookkeeping for traders who run the whole business from a handset. It is the shop's money notebook, not an accountant's ledger, and it keeps working when the network does not.
highlights: Sales, expenses, stock and debts recorded in seconds on a phone.
Works fully offline, then syncs to the cloud the moment signal returns.
Built for shop owners, with no bookkeeping vocabulary to learn first.
items._todo: TODO(owner): automated check found no chat launcher on yourcountant.com or app.yourcountant.com. Confirm the agent is live, or set hasAiAgent to false.

items.name: RAB Energy Solutions
items.label: client
items.summary: A solar and renewable energy installer based in Takoradi, serving homes and businesses across Ghana with panels, inverters, batteries and backup power.
highlights: Built for a local service business where most visitors arrive on a phone.
Presents panels, inverters, batteries and backup power for homes and businesses.
Runs a live chat agent that answers sizing and cost questions around the clock.
items.agentPrompt: Ask: what size solar system do I need?
items._todo: TODO(owner): confirm the client-work label for RAB Energy Solutions.

items.name: Hydrocom Limited
items.label: client
items.summary: A wholly Ghanaian-owned engineering, procurement and construction firm working since 1996. The site had to carry real institutional weight, because its readers decide on contracts worth millions.
highlights: Four service sectors presented clearly: water supply, energy, roads and buildings, and sanitation.
A project record front and centre, including the Karaga and Tsiame water supply schemes.
Written for an audience of funders and agencies, from the World Bank and DANIDA to UNDP.

items.name: SchoolSpec
items.label: own-product
items.summary: A complete school management system for basic schools in Ghana, from Creche to JHS 3. Everything the office used to do on paper, finished before the bell.
highlights: Four sign-in roles. Heads, teachers, parents and students each see only what belongs to them.
Mobile money fee collection with partial payments and automatic SMS receipts to parents.
Report cards printed under the school's own crest in a single click.

items.name: Fabri Manager
items.label: own-product
items.summary: Job management for the trades. Every enquiry, job, invoice and payment in one system, built hands-on inside a working fabrication shop rather than a boardroom.
highlights: One straight line from first enquiry to fully paid, with nothing lost in notebooks or chats.
A client portal that answers the "how far is my job?" call before it is made.
Serves fabricators, carpenters, plumbers, electricians, roofers and fit-out teams.

items.name: LettersReady
items.label: own-product
items.summary: A focused AI writing tool for business correspondence. Draft or reply to any professional letter in seconds, in the language your reader expects.
highlights: Professional letters drafted and answered in seconds, not hours.
Writes in English, French, Spanish and Arabic.
Secure accounts with saved history, on a modern application stack.
